title: Match Key
description: One identifier a party can resolve, the entity scopes it resolves at, and the uses it supports. Capability only: MUST NOT carry match rates, audience sizes, coverage, or per-user or per-graph data. Two keys are compatible at scope S when they share uid_type, both list S in scopes, and their vendor domains are equal when both declare vendor. Sellers using this shape list media_buy.match_keys in experimental_features.

uid_type.description: Identifier type. Match keys draw from uid-type only; supported_identifier_types is not a match-key source.

vendor.description: Graph or resolution vendor that produces this key at the declared scopes. Required when uid_type is other; otherwise declare it when the scope depends on a graph, for example maid resolved to households.

scopes.description: Entity granularities this key resolves at; list each when there are several. custom is not comparable across parties and is excluded.

uses.description: Purposes this key supports at the declared scopes.

property_types.description: Seller-wide declarations only: property types on which this key resolves. Omit to mean every property type the seller sells. Product-level keys inherit the product's property types.

allOf.description: A key outside the uid-type enum is identified by its vendor.
PAIR is publisher-scoped and rotates every 30 days, and unsalted hashed_email in TMP widens the identity-leak surface, so neither is forwarded to buyer-side Identity Match.
